title: CongressMemberRecordV1
description: A member of Congress's public record in BillBoard (UX-39d), from GET /congress-member-record: their latest roll-call vote on each bill in BillBoard, newest first, a page at a time, and the bills they sponsored; or, asked with billGuids, only their votes on those bills. Facts only, as Congress records them: no score, no ranking, no judging words, and no BillBoard user's vote.

votes.description: The member's latest roll-call vote on each bill in BillBoard that has one, newest first (by votedOn, then bill guid), at most the request's limit. Asked with billGuids: their votes on those bills only, in the same order, every one. A member in both chambers' latest roll calls of a bill (who moved chambers) has one entry for each. Empty for a member with no recorded vote, or past the last page.

nextCursor.description: Present when more votes follow: send it as cursor to read the next page. Absent on the last page, and with billGuids.

sponsoredBills.description: The bills in BillBoard the member sponsored (not cosponsored), from BillBoard's member stats: the 119th Congress and each later Congress counted apart (REL-46), newest Congress first, then by updatedAt, newest first. Only bills the bills manifest lists (a bill still waiting for its text is left out), except when the manifest could not be read, when every counted bill is sent and some lack a title. At most 250 (sponsoredBillCount is the whole number). Sent on the first page only (no cursor, no billGuids). Label them by each bill's congress (D78): from 2027-01-03 they span more than one Congress.

sponsoredBillCount.description: How many bills in BillBoard the member sponsored, sponsoredBills or more: the sum of sponsoredBillCounts. Sent with sponsoredBills.

sponsoredBillCounts.description: How many of those bills each Congress has, newest Congress first, one entry per Congress with at least one. Sent with sponsoredBills.

billGuid.description: The bill's plain guid, such as BILLS-119hr1234.

billType.description: From the guid, such as hr or s.

title.description: The bill's title as the bills manifest has it; absent when the bill has no manifest row yet.

chamber.description: The chamber whose roll call this is.

votedOn.description: The roll call's day as Congress records it, YYYY-MM-DD (Washington's day, with no time or zone): show it as it is, never converted to the device's time zone. A roll call without a day is not in the record.

actionText.description: What the roll call was on, as Congress words it (a passage, a cloture vote, a motion), at most 500 characters; absent when Congress gave none.

congress.description: The Congress, as each bill's congress writes it, such as 119.

count.description: How many of the member's sponsored bills it has.

position.title: CongressMemberRecordPositionV1
position.description: The member's position as Congress records it.

billGuid.description: The bill's plain guid, such as BILLS-119hr1234.

billType.description: From the guid, such as hr or s.

title.description: The bill's title as the bills manifest has it; absent when the bill has no manifest row yet.

vetoed.description: Only as true, when the bill's veto stands, as the bills manifest has it; absent otherwise.

updatedAt.description: The bill's date in the bills manifest (its latest news); absent without a manifest row.
